# authwise_realms (Data Source)

A realm: a population of users with its own providers, factors and authentication policy. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `realms` (Attributes List) Every realm under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--realms))

<a id="nestedatt--realms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `realms`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `realm_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
